text: Marketing is a discipline that studies how to achieve business goals by identifying, creating and delivering customer value. This major takes consumer demands as its core and integrates knowledge from multiple disciplines such as psychology, economics, and communication studies, aiming to cultivate compound talents with capabilities in market insight, brand planning, marketing execution, and data analysis. Students need to systematically master the full-process logic from market research, product positioning to promotion and communication, and learn to use digital tools (such as social media marketing, SEO/SEM) and traditional strategies (such as advertising placement, channel management) to solve business problems. It is suitable for students who are interested in consumer behavior, creative planning and business communication.
